description: Source code for Mistral API provider, including class MistralHandler with methods for streaming responses, prompt completion, and tool conversion, along with related types and helper functions.

classes.name: MistralHandler
classes.description: Class implementing a provider for Mistral API, handling streaming, prompt completion, and tool conversion.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Streams a message response from the Mistral API based on system prompt and messages.

methods.name: convertToolsForMistral
methods.description: Converts OpenAI tool definitions to Mistral format.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves current model configuration including ID, info, max tokens, and temperature.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the Mistral API and returns the generated text.

methods.name: fimSupport
methods.description: Provides FimHandler support if model ID starts with 'codestral-'.

methods.name: streamFim
methods.description: Streams FIM completions from the Mistral API with support for usage tracking.
